name: Aaron Smith

events.title: Marriage and family
events.description: Married Seviah, daughter of James Sands; children Othniel, Abigail, Sands, Jessie, Abner, Sarah and Seviah.

bioAdditions: A son of Job Smith 1st and Elizabeth Thompson (John's 10th-great-grandparents), so a brother of John's 9th-great-grandfather James Smith and John's 9th-great-granduncle. Thompson's Smith account (S1) gives his wife Seviah Sands and their children, including the patriot Abner Smith.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 377
sources.supports: Aaron son of Job 1st m. Seviah Sands; children
